name: Survivors Guilt
body:
A fallen ally inspires you to retaliate against your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +8.

Benefit: If an ally falls unconscious because of damage from an enemy attack, you may make a Power Attack as an immediate action against that enemy.

Special: If you have the Mighty Throw feat and the enemy is out of reach, you may make the Power Attack against the enemy with a thrown weapon.
